_documentation.purpose: Runs the nbn two temperature hotspot experiment or benchmark.
_documentation.authority: Values in this file are authoritative for its runner. A sweep value overrides the corresponding base-simulation value only for that named case; effective values are recorded in summary.json.

fields.simulation_config: Base production simulation JSON built before this runner applies documented experiment controls.
fields.run.sample_every: Save diagnostics every this many accepted steps.
fields.run.duration_multiplier: Runs for this multiple of the referenced simulation duration; the simulation remains the sole owner of the physical duration and timestep.
fields.magnetic_field.applied_Bz_T: Sets applied Bz T; units are tesla.
fields.magnetic_field.gauge: Vector-potential gauge used to represent the applied magnetic field.
fields.magnetic_field.calculate_self_field: Enables or disables calculate self field.
fields.magnetic_field.observation_height_m: Sets observation height m; units are metres.
fields.magnetic_field.source_stride: Spatial subsampling for magnetic diagnostics; larger values are faster and less resolved.
fields.validity.maximum_distance_from_Tc: Upper limit for distance from Tc.
fields.validity.maximum_thickness_over_xi: Upper limit for thickness over xi.
fields.validity.maximum_thickness_over_lambda: Upper limit for thickness over lambda.
fields.validity.maximum_spacing_over_xi: Upper limit for spacing over xi.
fields.initial_conditions.temperature_hotspot.e: Enables this model or output feature.
fields.initial_conditions.temperature_hotspot.p: Sets peak delta K; units are kelvin.
fields.vortex_detection.amplitude_floor: Minimum order-parameter amplitude at which phase winding is considered numerically reliable.
fields.output.directory: Base output directory; runners reserve a numbered sibling if it already exists.
fields.output.kymograph_centerline: Chooses the horizontal or vertical line sampled through time.
fields.output.vector_stride: Grid subsampling for plotted current and field arrows.
fields.output.gif.enabled: Enables this model or output feature.
fields.output.gif.fps: Playback frames per second for generated GIFs.
